style: Refine every catalog object toward warm, softly lit cartoon art, consistent with the selected plant reference. Preserve identity, function and original palette family. Keep registered camera, dimensions, roots, sockets, ports, footprints and animation timing. No preferred horizontal light direction for rotatable world sprites; no directional ground shadows. Real 3D render output, editable Blender sources. The source 2D effects remain explicitly identified as 2D. Each object receives fresh independent editor/judge agents. Publish object-by-object to the same PR preview; integrate approved sprites into Godot after catalog review checks. Follow-on design exploration: improve the modeling itself, including forms, proportions, structure, crafted details and decorations. Original part counts and awkward geometry are not constraints. The editor may rebuild native geometry to achieve the better design; the judge should reward useful improvements. Preserve the locked registration, gameplay contact/clearance, animation and modular continuity contract. See modeling-policy.json version2.

qualityCriteria.definitionOfGood: Compact warmly crafted red/gold launcher with cool rounded barrel, meaningful seated support and readable native recoil, clean in every standalone and frozen mounted view.

priorityOutcomes.outcome: A compact rounded launcher with visibly constructed cradle, side mass and projecting barrel/muzzle. Firm softened edges and useful thickness replace the broad low rectangular slab and blank rail. The barrel remains the main functional shape in all four views.
priorityOutcomes.evidence: Target shows red rounded paired side housings, warm yellow-gold support/bands and a cool barrel with side hardware. Build a coherent narrower native interpretation inside the frozen reservation; literal target width and part counts are not requirements.
failureExamples: Broad flat source block with only changed color
Arbitrary greebles that erase the launcher silhouette
A narrow featureless stick justified only by the width reservation

priorityOutcomes.outcome: A warm red/gold support family and a clearly separate cool blue-gray mechanical barrel/muzzle. Large color masses and modest material changes keep construction legible at logical and phone scales.
priorityOutcomes.evidence: Target provides warm gold/red versus cool metal hierarchy, while the family concept supports warm crafted submarine equipment.
failureExamples: Uniform dull gray or red that merges every part
White blown metal or yellow highlights that flatten volume
Dark outlines or excessive black cavities standing in for construction

priorityOutcomes.outcome: Soft broad reflections describe curved forms and bevels without a preferred horizontal light direction. All facings retain readable surface gradients and joints; no dark dead side or heavy directional cast ground shadow.
priorityOutcomes.evidence: Inspect all four native views under one common symmetric standalone rig and under the exact frozen main context.
failureExamples: One facing substantially darker or flatter than its rotated counterpart
Narrow glare strips, clipped highlights or nearly black underside patches
Copied ImageGen halo or baked-in one-sided painted highlight

priorityOutcomes.outcome: A few meaningful bands, hinge/slide junctions, rim transitions, fasteners or shallow panels communicate an assembled mechanism. Detail follows the forms and survives downsampling as hierarchy rather than noise.
priorityOutcomes.limits: The editor chooses construction and part count. No demand that every target bolt survives at phone size.

priorityOutcomes.outcome: Static cradle stays grounded while barrel/muzzle retract together and recover over the actual 12-frame nonloop gesture. Motion is discernible in standalone playback at logical and phone scale, with no joint detachment, sleeve clipping or deformation.
priorityOutcomes.limits: Preserve the source native phase offsets and residual end pose. Do not invent firing, cable, projectile or a cyclic pulse. Mounted diagnostics audit clearance across every phase; later main adopts neutral idle only.

priorityOutcomes.outcome: At the frozen transform, a credible foot is visibly seated on the finite rear patch and a raised forward structure clears the hull/glass. The muzzle points toward local -Y and reads as a launcher beside the submarine focal parts.
priorityOutcomes.limits: The frozen body is technical context. Other upgrades remain clearly provisional. This component review does not approve the main body.

priorityOutcomes.outcome: No intersecting hull/base, z-fighting, exposed detached ends, cracked corners, abrupt broken normals, muddy merged forms, clipping at any canvas edge, temporal sparkle, alpha fringes, target-plane substitution or dead spots in N/E/S/W idle and active.
priorityOutcomes.evidence: Inspect actual native images enlarged and at intended scale over light/gray/dark backgrounds, full phase sheets and ordinary browser sampling.
